content: Our baseline and topline results are in Table TABREF6 , where we measure translation performance using BLEU BIBREF13 , BEER BIBREF14 (higher is better) and characTER BIBREF15 (smaller is better). As they are trained from much smaller amounts of data than current systems, these baselines are not quite competitive to today's best system, but still represent serious baselines for these datasets. Given our setups, fine-tuning with in-domain natural data improves BLEU by almost 4 points for both translation directions on in-domain tests; it also improves, albeit by a smaller margin, the BLEU score of the out-of-domain tests.
